hex_address.input_semantics: hexadecimal integer text; ASCII/Unicode whitespace may appear as document formatting
hex_address.output_semantics: lowercase 0x prefix, uppercase hexadecimal digits, no separators, no leading zero padding

rules: Manufacturer-near identifiers are retained independently from Plasma commercial-part identity.
commercial_part_base comes only from deterministic target identity context and is never inferred from an AI-provided manufacturer reference.
Hexadecimal formatting differences are deterministic representation transformations, not AI semantic decisions.
Controlled vocabulary aliases are deterministic transformations; an unrecognized non-null label fails closed.
Evidence attached to an AI semantic fact must be propagated to canonical fields derived from that fact.
Canonical identity fields introduced from deterministic target context use the context authority citation rather than fabricated AI evidence.
Canonicalization does not grant canonical-dataset or production admission.
